cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.c1: A cookie is a file placed on your device when you visit a website. Its purpose is to collect information about your browsing and to provide you with services tailored to your device (computer, mobile or tablet).
cookies.c2: Pursuant to article 5(3) of directive 2002/58/CE, as amended, concerning the processing of personal data and the protection of privacy in the electronic communications sector, transposed into article 82 of loi n°78-17 du 6 janvier 1978 on data processing, files and individual liberties, trackers or cookies are subject to two distinct regimes.
cookies.c3: Cookies that are not strictly necessary for the service or whose sole purpose is not to facilitate electronic communication must be consented to by the user.
cookies.c4: This consent of the data subject for one or more specific purposes constitutes a legal basis within the meaning of the RGPD and must be understood within the meaning of article 6-a of Règlement (UE) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data.
cookies.c5: At any time, you can refuse the use of cookies and disable their placement on your computer by using the dedicated function of your browser (a function available in particular on Microsoft Internet Explorer 11, Google Chrome, Mozilla Firefox, Apple Safari and Opera).
cookies.c6: Some cookies are strictly necessary for the service or have the sole purpose of facilitating electronic communication and are exempt from prior consent under article 82 of loi n°78-17 du 6 janvier 1978.
cookies.c7: Cookies relating to public and anonymous statistics are also placed.
cookies.c8: The platform also uses the Matomo audience measurement solution, configured in « exempt » mode, in accordance with the recommendations of the CNIL. It therefore does not require the consent of the data subjects.
cookies.c9: To go further, you can consult the information sheets provided by the Commission Nationale de l’Informatique et des Libertés (CNIL):
cookies.c10: Cookies and trackers: what does the law say?

appField.title: 1. Scope
appField.c1: This document sets out the terms of use of the Je donne mon avis review submission form website, developed within the Direction Interministérielle du Numérique (DINUM).

platform.title: 2. Purpose of the platform
platform.c1: The form aims to give users of public procedures and services the opportunity to share their opinion on their experience following their use of these services.
platform.c2: The Je donne mon avis review submission form is developed and operated by the DINUM. Any use of this service must comply with these terms of use.

service.title: 3. Access to the service
service.c1: The form is made available to anyone wishing to share their opinion on a public digital service following their use of it.
service.c2: Use of the service is free and open and is not subject to the creation of a user account.

features.title: 4. Features
features.c1: The user can submit their opinion by answering a series of questions presented by the form.

engagement.title: 5. Commitments and responsibilities of users
engagement.c1: To find out more about the State’s digital accessibility policy:
engagement.c3: The service is made available to gather the opinions of users of public services with a view to their continuous improvement.
engagement.c4: The user is responsible for the data or content they enter in the various free-text fields of the form. They must take care to enter only appropriate messages.
engagement.c5: The user ensures that they keep their password secret. Any disclosure of the password, in whatever form, is prohibited. The user assumes the risks associated with the use of their email address and password.
engagement.c7: The user undertakes not to enter into the free-text fields of the form any content or information contrary to the legal and regulatory provisions in force.
engagement.c8: In particular, they undertake to communicate only the data strictly necessary for the assessment of the public digital service in question and to refrain, in the free-text fields, from revealing sensitive data concerning themselves or third parties (e.g. health data, political, philosophical or religious opinions), and from making insulting, defamatory, obscene remarks and, more generally, remarks contrary to the law and public order.
engagement.c9: It is recalled that any person who makes a false declaration on their own behalf or on behalf of another is liable, in particular, to the penalties provided for in article 441-1 du Code pénal, which provides for penalties of up to three years’ imprisonment and a fine of 45,000 euros.
engagement.c10: The user ensures, prior to publication, that it complies with the legal framework in force, in particular the RGPD, the loi Informatique et libertés, the Code de la propriété intellectuelle and the CRPA.
engagement.c11: The user undertakes not to publish, in discussion areas or anywhere else, messages that are racist, sexist, abusive, insulting or contrary to public order. Each published comment entails the assignment of its intellectual property rights on a non-exclusive basis, free of charge, worldwide and for the entire duration of these rights.

dinum.c1: 6.1 Security and access to the Platform
dinum.c2: The sources of the information published on the Platform are deemed reliable, but it does not guarantee that the Platform is free of defects, errors or omissions.
dinum.c3: The DINUM is committed to securing the Platform, in particular by taking all necessary measures to guarantee the security and confidentiality of the information provided.
dinum.c4: The DINUM undertakes to provide the necessary and reasonable means to ensure continuous access to the Platform.
dinum.c5: The DINUM reserves the right to develop, modify or suspend, without notice, the service for maintenance reasons or for any other reason deemed necessary.
dinum.c6: The DINUM reserves the right to suspend or delete a user account of the service that has breached these terms of use, without prejudice to any criminal and civil liability actions that may be brought against the user.
